label: Flat abs relief

range.endpoint_anchor: 1.0 = the source sculpt's own relief depth at the canonical station, frame-scaled to hm08 (closed-loop calibrated; see qa)

semantics: Rectus relief at value 1: the abdomen centre sits one calibrated flattening depth (2.70 mm at the canonical station) below its flanks inside the footprint band, with the linea alba groove at 0.91 mm. Pure relief: no mass, no radius change outside the footprint.
